blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Neural speech codecs increasingly serve as tokenizers for speech language models (SLMs).
Lowering the frame rate reduces the computational and memory costs of SLMs, but makes it difficult to preserve both linguistic information and acoustic detail.
Existing approaches rely on rule-based compression: average pooling can discard linguistic information, whereas similarity-based merging uses a fixed threshold on adjacent-frame similarity and applies the resulting boundaries to the acoustic stream.
We propose Q-SPT, a low-frame-rate dual-stream speech tokenizer with separate, context-aware, learnable query-based compressors specialized for semantic and acoustic representations.
In particular, queries at a fixed rate independently attend to the semantic and acoustic streams as separate key–value sources, enabling stream-specific, context-aware aggregation through two separately learned compressors.
In addition, an autoregressive text loss explicitly supervises the semantic compressor to preserve linguistic information.
Experimental results show that Q-SPT achieves the best reconstruction among the evaluated codecs at the same frame rate. In downstream SLMs, it yields the best speech recognition accuracy and text-to-speech perceptual quality with competitive intelligibility.
blocks.zh:
神经语音编码器日益成为语音语言模型(SLMS)的标注器.
降低帧率会降低可持续土地管理的计算和内存成本,但很难同时保存语言信息和声学细节.
现有方法依赖于基于规则的压缩:平均集合可以丢弃语言信息,而基于相似性的合并则使用相邻帧相似性的固定阈值,并将所形成的边界应用于相声流.
我们提出Q-SPT,是一种低帧率的双流语音标语器,具有独立的,上下文感知,可学习的基于查询的压缩器,专门用于语义和相声表达.
特别是,以固定速度独立处理语义流和相声流作为单独的密钥-值源,通过两个分别学习的压缩器使流具有特定上下文意识的聚合成为可能.
此外,自递式文本丢失会明确监督语义压缩器,以保存语言信息.
实验结果显示,Q-SPT在被评价的解码器中以相同的帧率实现了最好的重建. 在下游可持续土地管理中,它能产生最好的语音识别精度和文字对语音的能见度,具有竞争性的能见度。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Neural speech codecs compress speech into compact discrete tokens and reconstruct waveforms while preserving perceptual quality [ 7 , 20 , 35 ] . These codecs increasingly serve as tokenizers for speech language models (SLMs), enabling speech understanding and generation through language modeling over discrete speech tokens [ 8 , 5 ] . Effective speech tokenization therefore requires representations that support both high-quality waveform reconstruction and downstream speech modeling.
blocks.zh: 神经语音编解码器将语音压缩为紧凑的离散符号并重建出波形,同时保持知觉质量[7,20,35]. 这些编解码器日益成为语音模型(SLMS)的标注器,通过语言模型而不是离散的语音符号[8,5],使语音理解和生成成为可能. 因此,有效的语音符号化需要既支持高质量波形重建又支持下游语音模型的表示.

blocks.en: Recent codecs represent speech with fewer tokens by reducing the number of codebooks per frame [ 33 , 15 ] or the temporal resolution [ 8 , 2 ] , while maintaining reconstruction quality. The reduced token rate also improves the efficiency of SLMs by lowering the computational and memory costs of both training and inference [ 2 , 8 ] . However, at extremely low frame rates, each token must carry more speech content, making it difficult to preserve both linguistic information and acoustic detail [ 23 ] .
blocks.zh: 最近的解码器通过减少每个帧的代码册数量[33,15]或时间解析[8,2]来代表代号较少的语音,同时保持重建质量. 象征性费率的降低还降低了培训和推断的计算和记忆成本,从而提高了可持续土地管理的效率[2、8]。 然而,以极低的帧率,每个符号必须携带更多的语音内容,使得语言信息和音响细节都难以保存. [23].

blocks.en:
To enhance linguistic information while retaining acoustic detail, prior codecs leverage pretrained speech representations. SpeechTokenizer [ 36 ] and Mimi [ 8 ] distill self-supervised learning (SSL) features into the first residual vector quantization (RVQ) [ 35 ] layer, while X-Codec [ 34 ] fuses semantic and acoustic features before quantization. More recently, dual-stream codecs encode semantic and acoustic features in separate streams to preserve both [ 22 , 23 ] . DualCodec [ 22 ] downsamples SSL features to a fixed frame rate by average pooling, but this uniform averaging can discard linguistic information at extremely low frame rates, degrading intelligibility [ 16 , 23 ] .
FlexiCodec [ 23 ] instead merges adjacent frames based on semantic similarity, improving information preservation at average frame rates as low as 6.25 Hz. However, the same merging boundaries are applied to the acoustic stream, although semantically similar frames may still differ in acoustic detail.
Moreover, the merging rule relies only on adjacent-frame similarity with a fixed threshold, so it neither uses broader temporal context nor is optimized by the training objective.
blocks.zh:
为了在保留声学细节的同时增强语言信息,前作的解码器会利用被预先训练的语音表达. SpeechTokenizer [36]和Mimi [8] 蒸馏自控学习(SSL)特征进入了第一个残余向量分解(RVQ) [35]层,而X-Codec [34]则在分解前将语义和声学特征相接. 最近,双流编码器在相隔的溪流中编码语义和相声特征,以保留两者[22,23]. DualCodec [22] 将SSL的特征降低到平均集合的固定帧速率,但这种统一平均率可以以极低的帧速率丢弃语言信息,贬低了知觉 [16,23].
Flexi Cadec [23] 转而根据语义相似性合并相邻帧,以平均帧率低至6.25赫兹来改进信息保存. 然而,相同的并联边界被应用到相声流上,尽管相声相似的帧在相声细节上仍然可能有所不同.
此外,合并规则只依靠有固定门槛的相邻框架相似性,因此既不使用更广泛的时间背景,也不被训练目标所优化.

blocks.en:
We propose Q-SPT , a low-frame-rate dual-stream speech tokenizer based on learnable query-based compression. Unlike rule-based compression such as average pooling or similarity-based merging (Fig. 1 (a)–(b)), Q-SPT compresses features through cross-attention with learnable queries, which adaptively weight frames within each temporal window (Fig. 1 (c)).
Since the semantic and acoustic streams carry different information, Q-SPT employs separate semantic and acoustic compressors, each with a distinct temporal context accessible to its fixed-rate queries.
In addition, because reconstruction objectives supervise linguistic content only implicitly, we add an autoregressive text loss that explicitly supervises the semantic compressor.
By conditioning autoregressive transcript prediction on the semantic queries, this loss encourages the semantic tokens to retain linguistic information for downstream SLMs.
blocks.zh:
我们提出Q-SPT,一种基于可学习的基于查询压缩的低帧率双流语音表示器. 与基于规则的压缩,如平均集合或基于相似性的合并(图1 (a)-(b))不同,Q-SPT通过与可学习的查询的交叉注意力来压缩特征,这些查询在每个时间窗口内适应性地加权框架(图1 (c)).
由于语义流和相声流携带不同的信息,Q-SPT使用单独的语义和相声压缩器,每个都具有独特的时间上下文,可供其固定率查询.
此外,由于重建目标只是隐含地监督语言内容,所以我们增加了一个自旋式文本丢失,明确监督语义压缩器.
这种损失通过对语义查询进行自递性记录预测,鼓励语义符号保留下游可持续土地管理的语言信息。

blocks.en:
Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We present Q-SPT, which replaces rule-based temporal compression in dual-stream speech tokenization with learnable query-based compression specialized for each stream .
Separate semantic and acoustic compressors with distinct temporal contexts adaptively weight frames to preserve both linguistic information and acoustic detail. • We introduce an autoregressive text loss that explicitly supervises the semantic compressor through transcript prediction, which improves the preservation of linguistic information in the semantic tokens and leads to gains in both reconstruction and downstream SLM performance. • Experiments show that Q-SPT achieves the best reconstruction among the evaluated codecs at the same frame rate and, in downstream SLMs, the best automatic speech recognition (ASR) performance and text-to-speech (TTS) perceptual quality.
blocks.zh:
• 我们的贡献概述如下: 我们提出Q-SPT, 它将双流语音符号化中的基于规则的时间压缩替换为每个流的可学习的基于查询的压缩 。
单独的语义和声学压缩器,具有不同的时间背景,适应性地分量框架来保存语言信息和声学细节. ^ 我们引入了自动递减文本损失,通过记录誊本预测明确监督语义压缩器,这改善了语义符号中语言信息的保存,并导致在重建和下游可持续土地管理业绩方面都取得了收益。 • 实验表明,Q-SPT以同样的帧率在被评价的可解码器中实现最佳重建,在下游可持续土地管理中,实现最佳的自动语音识别性能和文字对语音(TTS)感知质量。

blocks.en:
We present Q-SPT, which replaces rule-based temporal compression in dual-stream speech tokenization with learnable query-based compression specialized for each stream .
Separate semantic and acoustic compressors with distinct temporal contexts adaptively weight frames to preserve both linguistic information and acoustic detail.
blocks.zh:
我们提出Q-SPT, 它将双流语音符号化中的基于规则的时间压缩替换为每个流的可学习的基于查询的压缩 。
具有不同时间背景的单独语义和声学压缩器在适应性上为权重框架来保存语言信息和声学细节.

blocks.en: We introduce an autoregressive text loss that explicitly supervises the semantic compressor through transcript prediction, which improves the preservation of linguistic information in the semantic tokens and leads to gains in both reconstruction and downstream SLM performance.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了自递式文字损失,通过文字记录预测明确监督语义压缩器,改进了语义符号中语言信息的保存,并导致在重建和下游可持续土地管理业绩上有所收获.

blocks.en: Experiments show that Q-SPT achieves the best reconstruction among the evaluated codecs at the same frame rate and, in downstream SLMs, the best automatic speech recognition (ASR) performance and text-to-speech (TTS) perceptual quality.
blocks.zh: 实验表明,Q-SPT以相同的帧率在被评价的可解码器中实现最佳重建,在下游的可持续土地管理中,实现最好的自动语音识别性能和文字对语音(TTS)感知质量.

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en:
Fig. 1 (d) illustrates the architecture of Q-SPT. A frozen ASR encoder [ 1 ] and a DAC-based codec encoder [ 20 ] extract semantic and acoustic features from speech, respectively. Separate semantic and acoustic compressors use learnable queries to compress the two feature sequences to 6.25 Hz. Semantic tokens are obtained by finite scalar quantization (FSQ) [ 26 ] , and acoustic tokens are obtained by applying RVQ to the residual between the acoustic and quantized semantic representations [ 22 ] . The sum of the two quantized representations is upsampled by a Transformer with mask tokens, and the DAC-based codec decoder reconstructs speech from the upsampled representation.
During training, an autoregressive text loss additionally supervises the semantic compressor through transcript prediction.
blocks.zh:
图1(d)说明了Q-SPT的结构。 一个被冻结的ASR编码器[1]和一个基于DAC的编码器[20]分别从语音中提取语义和相声特征. 单独的语义和相声压缩器使用可学习的查询来将两个特征序列压缩为 6.25 Hz. 相声符号由有限度的相声分解(FSQ)[26]得到,相声分解符号通过将RVQ应用到相声分解的相声分解和相声分解的相声分解的相声分解的相声分解[22]得到. 两个被分解的表示式的总和由带有口罩符的变形器进行上标,基于DAC的编码解码器从被分解的表示式中重建出语音.
在训练期间,自动回转的文本丢失会额外通过笔录预测来监督语义压缩器.

blocks.en: 2.1 Learnable Query-Based Compression
blocks.zh: 2.1 可学习的以查询为基础的压缩

blocks.en: Given a 16-kHz waveform 𝐱 ∈ ℝ L \mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{L} , a frozen SenseVoice-Small [ 1 ] ASR encoder extracts semantic features 𝐅 s ∈ ℝ T s × d \mathbf{F}^{s}\in\mathbb{R}^{T_{s}\times d} at approximately 16.7 Hz, and the codec encoder extracts acoustic features 𝐅 a ∈ ℝ T a × d \mathbf{F}^{a}\in\mathbb{R}^{T_{a}\times d} at 12.5 Hz. Here, T s T_{s} and T a T_{a} denote the sequence lengths of the semantic and acoustic features, respectively, and d d is the feature dimension. Each compressor is a stack of Transformer layers in which learnable queries aggregate its input features within a sliding window through cross-attention [ 21 ] . Both compressors output 𝐇 s , 𝐇 a ∈ ℝ T × d \mathbf{H}^{s},\mathbf{H}^{a}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times d} at a common frame rate of 6.25 Hz, where T = ⌈ T a / 2 ⌉ T=\lceil T_{a}/2\rceil is the compressed sequence length.

blocks.en:
Causal semantic compression. The semantic compressor uses a wide window with causal attention to capture linguistic information over a broader temporal context.
Specifically, the i i -th query ( i = 1 , … , T i=1,\ldots,T ) cross-attends to a window of w s w_{s} semantic frames ending at the e i e_{i} -th frame, where e i = ⌈ i ​ T s / T ⌉ e_{i}=\lceil iT_{s}/T\rceil is the last semantic frame within its time span. This window moves with the query index and is truncated at the utterance start, forming a causal sliding window. We set w s = 16 w_{s}=16 , which corresponds to approximately 0.96 s.
Causal self-attention over the query sequence additionally provides preceding context beyond the local cross-attention window. To preserve the relative temporal order of queries and semantic frames, we apply rotary position embeddings (RoPE) [ 32 ] to both attentions.

Local acoustic compression. The acoustic compressor uses a narrow window to retain fine-grained acoustic detail.
Specifically, the i i -th query cross-attends to a window of w a w_{a} acoustic frames starting at the ( 2 ​ i − 1 ) (2i-1) -th frame. We set w a = 3 w_{a}=3 , which corresponds to approximately 0.24 s.

Quantization and waveform reconstruction. The semantic representation 𝐇 s \mathbf{H}^{s} is quantized into 𝐇 ^ s ∈ ℝ T × d \widehat{\mathbf{H}}^{s}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times d} by FSQ [ 26 ] with temporal ConvNeXt layers [ 24 ] .

The DAC-based codec decoder [ 20 ] then reconstructs the waveform 𝐱 ^ ∈ ℝ L \widehat{\mathbf{x}}\in\mathbb{R}^{L} from the upsampled features.

blocks.en: 2.2 Training with Autoregressive Text Supervision
blocks.zh: 2.2 自动递减文本监督培训

blocks.en: Q-SPT is trained end-to-end with the ASR encoder kept frozen. In addition to the standard codec losses for waveform reconstruction [ 20 , 22 ] , we use two types of losses to enhance linguistic information in the semantic stream. An autoregressive text loss provides explicit supervision on linguistic content, whereas semantic reconstruction losses implicitly guide the semantic tokens to retain the information in the ASR features.
blocks.zh: Q-SPT被训练出端到端,ASR编码器一直被冻结. 除了波形重建的标准解码器损失[20,22]之外,我们还使用两种类型的损失来增强语义流中的语言信息. 自动后退的文本丢失对语言内容提供了明确的监督,而语义重建损失则隐含地引导语义符号保留ASR特征中的信息.

blocks.en: Autoregressive text loss. Since reconstruction objectives provide only implicit supervision for linguistic content, we explicitly supervise the semantic compressor with the ground-truth transcript of the input speech 𝐱 \mathbf{x} . During training, the transcript is tokenized into 𝐲 = ( y 0 , y 1 , … , y M ) \mathbf{y}=(y_{0},y_{1},\ldots,y_{M}) with the BERT tokenizer [ 10 ] , where y 0 y_{0} is a start token and M M is the number of target tokens. The embedded tokens are concatenated after the semantic queries, and the resulting sequence is processed by the semantic compressor. Queries and text tokens share the same self-attention layers, whereas text tokens bypass cross-attention and use a separate text feed-forward network (FFN). Queries attend causally only among themselves and cannot attend to text tokens. In contrast, each text token attends to all queries and causally to the text tokens, so the loss supervises the compressor without leaking text into the query states. The text FFN outputs are then projected by an LM head to predict each next token. The autoregressive text loss is the next-token cross-entropy, ℒ AR = − 1 M ∑ m = 1 M log p θ ( y m ∣ 𝐱 , 𝐲 < m ) , \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{AR}}=-\frac{1}{M}\sum_{m=1}^{M}\log p_{\theta}\!\left(y_{m}\mid\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y}_{<m}\right), (1) where p θ p_{\theta} denotes the predicted distribution from the LM head, conditioned on 𝐱 \mathbf{x} through the semantic queries and on the preceding tokens 𝐲 < m \mathbf{y}_{<m} .

For reconstruction, a multi-scale mel-spectrogram loss ℒ mel \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{mel}} between 𝐱 \mathbf{x} and 𝐱 ^ \widehat{\mathbf{x}} is used, following DAC [ 20 ] . For quantization, RVQ is trained with a codebook loss ℒ cb \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{cb}} and a commitment loss ℒ cm \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{cm}} [ 20 ] . blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3个实验

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Datasets. For codec training, we use speech–text pairs with utterance durations of at most 30 s from LibriHeavy [ 17 ] , GigaSpeech [ 3 ] , and the English subset of Emilia [ 11 ] , totaling about 47.7k hours. All speech is resampled to 16 kHz. SLMs are trained on the full 960-hour LibriSpeech training set [ 27 ] . All experiments are evaluated on LibriSpeech test-clean.
blocks.zh: 数据集. 在编解码训练方面,我们使用语音文本配对,在LibriHeavy[17]、GigaSpeech[3]和Emilia[11]的英文子集中,其语音长度最多为30 s,总计约47.7k小时。 所有语音被重印到16千赫. 可持续土地管理人员接受960小时LibriSpeech全套培训[27]。 所有实验均在LibriSpeech测试-清洁上进行评估.

blocks.en: Implementation details. Q-SPT has 104.1M parameters at inference, excluding the frozen ASR encoder. Each compressor consists of three Transformer layers. The semantic FSQ has a vocabulary of 32,768 codes, and each of the seven acoustic RVQ codebooks has 4,096 entries. The codec is trained for 950k steps on 8 NVIDIA L40S GPUs using AdamW with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} and dynamic batches of up to 30 s of audio per GPU.
blocks.zh: 执行细节。 Q-SPT有104.1M参数推论,不包括被冻结的ASR编码器. 每个压缩机由三个变形器层组成. 语义FSQ有32,768个代码的词汇,而7个相声的RVQ编码本各有4,096个条目. 编码器在8个NVIDIA L40S GPU上的950k阶上被训练出,使用AdamW的学习速度为10−4 10^{-4}每个GPU的动态分批可达30 s的音频.

blocks.en: For SLM experiments, we fully fine-tune a separate Qwen3.5-4B [ 28 ] for each codec, jointly on ASR and TTS in a 1:1 ratio, using tokens extracted from the frozen codec. ASR predicts text from the first stream, whereas TTS generates all eight streams in parallel with a delay pattern [ 6 ] that shifts each stream by one frame. Each SLM is trained for 20k steps with a global batch size of 128 using AdamW with a learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} . FlexiCodec-based TTS additionally predicts per-token frame lengths with a duration head [ 23 ] .
blocks.zh: 就可持续土地管理实验而言,我们用从被冻结的可解码器中提取的道具,在ASR和TTS上用1:1的比例对每个可解码器单独调整出一个Quen3.5-4B[28]。 ASR预测从第一流得到的文本,而TTS则会同时生成出所有8个流并发的延迟图案[6],将每个流相移为一帧. 每个可持续土地管理都经过20克级培训,全球批量规模为128个,使用AdamW,学习率为2×10−4 2\times 10×4}。 Flexi Codec-基于TTS的额外预测每根托起的帧长度有持续时间头 [23].

blocks.en: Baselines. At 12.5 Hz, we compare with Mimi [ 8 ] , OmniCodec [ 13 ] , LM-SPT [ 16 ] , and DualCodec [ 22 ] . At 6.25 Hz, we compare with FlexiCodec [ 23 ] and DualCodec. We adapt DualCodec to 6.25 Hz by modifying its stride settings and train it on the same data as Q-SPT. For FlexiCodec, we use the official threshold τ = 0.867 \tau=0.867 , which yields a nominal frame rate of 6.25 Hz.
blocks.zh: 在12.5赫兹时,我们与Mimi[8]、OmniCodec[13]、LM-SPT[16]和DualCodec[22]比较。在6.25赫兹时,我们与FlexiCodec[23]和DualCodec比较。 我们修改了DualCodec,使其适应6.25Hz,修改了速度设置,并用与Q-SPT相同的数据对其进行培训。 对于FlexiCodec,我们使用官方阈值 \ = 0.867\tau= 0.867,其名义帧率为 6.25 Hz.

blocks.en: Evaluation metrics. We denote the number of code streams used for reconstruction by n q n_{q} , where n q = 1 n_{q}=1 uses only the semantic stream and n q = 8 n_{q}=8 uses all eight streams. We report word error rate (WER) and speaker similarity (SIM) at n q = 1 n_{q}=1 and n q = 8 n_{q}=8 , and additionally report Perceptual Evaluation of Speech Quality in narrowband and wideband modes (PESQ-NB/WB) [ 30 ] , mel-cepstral distortion (MCD) [ 19 ] , and UTMOS [ 31 ] at n q = 8 n_{q}=8 . For SLMs, we report ASR and TTS WER, together with UTMOS and DNSMOS [ 29 ] for TTS quality. Reconstruction and TTS WER are computed with a HuBERT-Large ASR model [ 12 ] , and SIM with a fine-tuned WavLM-Large speaker-verification model with an ECAPA-TDNN backend [ 4 , 9 ] . At n q = 1 n_{q}=1 , lower SIM indicates less speaker information retained in the semantic stream, whereas higher SIM is preferred at n q = 8 n_{q}=8 . Bitrates are computed from the frame rate and codebook sizes, including three bits per output frame for FlexiCodec’s frame-length information [ 23 ] .
blocks.zh: 评价尺度。 我们表示用于重建的代码流由 n q n_{q} 表示, n q = 1 n_{q}=1只使用语义流, n q = 8 n_{q}=8使用所有8个流. 我们以 n q = 1 n_{q}=1和 n q = 8 n_{q}=8 报告字词误差率(WER)和扬声器相近性(SIM),另外还报告对窄带和宽带模式(PESQ-NB/WB)的语音质量进行概念评价[30],以mel-cepstral扭曲(MCD)[19],和UTMOS [31] 在n q = 8 n_{q}=8 。对于可持续土地管理,我们以 UTMOS 和 DNSMOS [29] 为TTS质量报告ASR和TTTS WER。 重构和TTS WER采用HuBERT-Large ASR模型[12]计算,SIM采用微调的WavLM-Large扬声器-验证模型,并配有ECAPA-TDNN后端[4,9]. 在n q = 1 n q q}=1时,下 SIM 表示在语义流中保留的扬声器信息较少,而高 SIM 则在n q = 8 n q}=8 时首选. 比特速率根据帧速率和代码簿大小计算,包括FlexiCodec的帧长信息每个输出帧三个比特. [23].

blocks.en: 3.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 3.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Codec reconstruction. Table 1 compares the reconstruction performance of speech codecs. At 6.25 Hz, Q-SPT achieves the best results on all metrics, including the lowest WER at both n q = 1 n_{q}=1 and n q = 8 n_{q}=8 . DualCodec performs strongly at 12.5 Hz, but when adapted to 6.25 Hz, its WER at n q = 1 n_{q}=1 increases from 5.19 to 48.95 and its acoustic quality also degrades. This suggests that average-pooling-based compression struggles to preserve information at extremely low frame rates. FlexiCodec preserves linguistic information better, with a WER of 4.58 at n q = 1 n_{q}=1 , but shows lower quality than Q-SPT on all n q = 8 n_{q}=8 quality metrics, even at a slightly higher bitrate. This is consistent with its semantic-derived merging boundaries being applied to the acoustic stream. Q-SPT also yields the lowest SIM at n q = 1 n_{q}=1 among the 6.25-Hz codecs and higher SIM than FlexiCodec at n q = 8 n_{q}=8 , indicating that speaker information is effectively separated from the semantic stream and recovered through the acoustic residual streams. Notably, at roughly half the bitrate, Q-SPT achieves higher UTMOS than all 12.5-Hz codecs.
blocks.zh: 代码重建. 表1比较了语音解码器的重建性能. 在 6.25 Hz 时,Q-SPT 在所有度量衡上都取得了最佳成绩,包括最低的WER 均以 n q = 1 n_{q}=1和 n q = 8 n_{q}=8为标准. 双科迪克在12: 5时表现强劲 Hz,但被改造为 6.25 Hz后,其n q = 1 n_{q}=1的WER从 5.19 被提升到 48.95,其声学质量也退化. 这表明,基于平均集合的压缩在以极低的帧率保存信息上挣扎. FlexiCodec保存语言信息更好,在n q = 1 n_{q}=1时WER为4.58,但在所有n q = 8 n_{q}=8质量度量衡上显示质量低于Q-SPT,即使比特率略高. 这符合其语义衍生的合并边界被应用于相声流. Q-SPT在 6.25-Hz codecs中也产生最低SIM = 1 n_{q}=1,在 nq = 8 n_{q}=8中比FlexiCodec 更高SIM,表明扬声器信息与语义流有效分离并被通过相声余流被恢复. 值得注意的是,以大约一半的比特率,Q-SPT实现了比所有12.5-Hz编码器更高的UTMOS.

blocks.en: Downstream speech modeling. Table 2 shows the ASR and TTS performance of SLMs trained on the tokens of each codec. For ASR, which uses only the semantic tokens, Q-SPT outperforms all baselines with a WER of 5.88, indicating that it preserves linguistic information that the SLM can effectively exploit. In contrast, DualCodec ∗ fails to produce meaningful transcriptions, suggesting that the limitation of average-pooling-based compression carries over to downstream modeling. For TTS, Q-SPT achieves the best perceptual quality in both UTMOS and DNSMOS, improving UTMOS from 3.05 to 3.44 over FlexiCodec. FlexiCodec, which additionally uses a duration head, achieves a lower WER but lower perceptual quality. This trend is consistent with Table 1 , where FlexiCodec also shows lower full-stream perceptual quality than Q-SPT.
blocks.zh: 下游语音模特. 表2显示按每个编码符号培训的可持续土地管理的ASR和TTS性能。 对于只使用语义符号的ASR,Q-SPT以5.88的WER比出所有基线,表示它保存了可持续土地管理能有效利用的语言信息. 相形之下,DualCodec ∗ 未能产生有意义的抄录,说明基于平均集合的压缩的局限性延伸到下游的模型。 对于TTS来说,Q-SPT在UTMOS和DNSMOS都实现了最佳的感知质量,将UTMOS从3.05提高到了FlexiCodec上方的3.44. Flexi Codec(英语:Flexi Codec (film)),它额外使用一个持续期头,实现了较低的WER,但知觉质量更低. 这一趋势与表1一致,其中FlexiCodec也显示出低于Q-SPT的全流感知质量.

blocks.en: 3.3 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 3.3 阅读研究

blocks.en: To analyze how each design choice contributes to Q-SPT, we conduct three ablations in Table 3 . First, we share the compressor parameters across the two streams to test whether each stream benefits from its own parameters. Second, we match the acoustic window boundaries to those of the semantic compressor, analogous to the shared merging boundaries in FlexiCodec, to examine how reconstruction quality changes. Third, we remove the autoregressive text loss to measure the effect of explicit linguistic supervision. The first and third variants are trained with the same setup as Q-SPT, whereas the second is applied only at inference.
blocks.zh: 为了分析每个设计选择如何有助于Q-SPT,我们在表3中进行了三次模拟。 首先,我们分享两条流的压缩器参数,以测试每条流是否从自己的参数中受益. 其次,我们把相声窗口的边界与语义压缩器的边界相匹配,类似于弗莱克西科德克的共享合并边界,以考察重建质量如何变化. 第三,我们消除了自递式文本损失,以衡量明确语言监督的效果. 第一种和第三种变体与Q-SPT相同的设置得到训练,而第二种则仅在推断时适用.

blocks.en: Shared weights. We share the Transformer layers of the two compressors while keeping the temporal windows of each stream. The shared-weight variant uses six layers to match the parameter count of the two three-layer compressors, and both variants are trained without the autoregressive text loss. Sharing the layers degrades both streams, increasing WER at n q = 1 n_{q}=1 from 4.97 to 6.16 and worsening WER and PESQ-WB at n q = 8 n_{q}=8 , while UTMOS remains nearly unchanged. This indicates that separate compressor parameters are more effective than shared parameters for modeling the semantic and acoustic streams.
blocks.zh: 共享重量。 我们分享两个压缩机的变压器层,同时保留每个流的时间窗口. 共分量的变体使用六层来匹配两个三层压缩机的参数计数,两个变体都经过了训练,没有自递式文本丢失. 分享地层可降解出两条溪流,从4.97到6.16,在nq=1n_{q}=1时增加WER,在nq=8n_{q}=8时使WER和PESQ-WB恶化,而UTMOS几乎保持不变. 这表明单独的压缩器参数比共享参数更能建模语义流和相声流.

blocks.en: Shared boundaries. To examine how sharing temporal boundaries across streams affects reconstruction, we match the acoustic window boundaries to those of the semantic compressor. At inference, each acoustic window is shifted to end at the same point in time as the corresponding semantic window, while the window size and all trained parameters remain unchanged. As the semantic stream is unchanged, WER at n q = 1 n_{q}=1 remains at 4.29, whereas at n q = 8 n_{q}=8 , WER increases from 2.52 to 3.83 and PESQ-WB and UTMOS also decrease. This indicates that the trained acoustic compressor relies on its own temporal boundaries, and that imposing the semantic boundaries at inference degrades acoustic reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 共享边界。 为了研究跨流时间边界的共享如何影响重建,我们将相声窗口边界与语义压缩机的边界相匹配. 推断出,每个相声窗口会和相应的语义窗口在同一时点转向结束,而窗口大小和所有训练过的参数保持不变. 由于语义流未变,nq=1nqq}=1的WER仍为4.29;而nq=8nqq}=8的WER从2.52增加到3.83;PESQ-WB和UTMOS也有所下降. 这表明训练有素的相声压缩机依赖于其自身的时间界限,而推想时强制的语义边界会降解相声重建.

blocks.en:
Text supervision. To measure the effect of explicit linguistic supervision, we compare separate-compressor models trained with and without ℒ AR \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{AR}} . Adding ℒ AR \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{AR}} reduces WER at n q = 1 n_{q}=1 from 4.97 to 4.29, while slightly improving all n q = 8 n_{q}=8 metrics. The benefit also transfers to downstream SLMs, reducing ASR WER from 7.04 to 5.88 and TTS WER from 12.31 to 11.82 (Table 2 ). Without ℒ AR \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{AR}} , Q-SPT already outperforms FlexiCodec on all reported n q = 8 n_{q}=8 reconstruction metrics, but not on WER at n q = 1 n_{q}=1 (4.97 vs. 4.58).
Thus, autoregressive text supervision complements the proposed query-based compression by further strengthening linguistic information in the semantic tokens.
blocks.zh:
文本监督. 为了衡量明确语言监督的效果,我们比较了经过培训的与L AR\mathcal{L}_{\-mathrm{AR}}-无关的单独压缩器模型. 添加 L AR \ mathcal{ L}_{\Q}_{\ mathrm{ AR}} 将 WER at n q = 1 n_{q}=1 从 4.97 被降为 4.29 ,同时略微改进所有 n q = 8 n_{q}=8 公分. 好处还转移到下游可持续土地管理,将ASR WER从7.04减少到5.88,TTS WER从12.31减少到11.82(表2)。 没有 L AR\ mathcal{ L}_{\- mathrm{ AR}}- , Q- SPT 已经超过效果 FlexiCodec on all reported n q = 8 n_{q}=8重建度量衡,但在n q = 1 n_{q}=1(4.97 vs 4.58)的WER上没有.
因此,自递式文本监督通过进一步加强语义符号中的语言信息来补充拟议的以查询为基础的压缩.

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: We proposed Q-SPT, a low-frame-rate dual-stream speech tokenizer that replaces rule-based temporal compression with learnable query-based compression and supervises the semantic compressor with an autoregressive text loss. At 6.25 Hz, Q-SPT achieves the best reconstruction among the evaluated codecs, while effectively separating speaker information from the semantic stream. In addition, the autoregressive text loss further strengthens linguistic information in the semantic tokens. These benefits carry over to downstream SLMs, where Q-SPT outperforms the baselines in ASR accuracy and TTS perceptual quality while maintaining competitive intelligibility.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了Q-SPT,一种低帧率的双流语音标语器,它用可学习的基于查询的压缩取代了基于规则的时间压缩,并以自旋式文本丢失来监督语义压缩器. 在6.25 Hz,Q-SPT在被评价的解码器中实现了最好的重建,同时有效地将扬声器信息从语义流中分离出. 此外,自递文本丢失会进一步加强语义符号中的语言信息. 这些好处延续到下游可持续土地管理,其中Q-SPT在ASR精度和TTS知觉质量上超过了基线,同时保持了竞争性的通晓性.
